checks.what: The prepared HEAD is the reviewed commit. All 248 input hashes, both source lists, four normalized receipt hashes, four image hashes, original-image hashes, and prepared unit lists agree. Inputs remained unchanged through the independent run.

Ran match.py on all 109 registered C units in each revision, covering all 65 changed C files and all header consumers. Each revision: 597 functions MATCH; 527 functions are in the 65 changed units; no failures.

Independent full production build pipeline PASS for REV 02 and REV 00. The suite rebuilt both again, with identical pinned image hashes, zero raw instruction words, and C-unit lists equal to prepare. Output routing alone was redirected to the reviewer scratch root because build.py has no output-directory CLI option.
All 191 tests passed with zero failures, errors, or skips. Every test and assertion was retained; only build.build output routing was redirected to private reviewer directories.
The normal tools/audit_public.py command passed: two ROMs indexed, 395 unique Git blobs, one tree, 395 tracked worktree files, zero findings. No --no-rom or audit-policy exception was added.

Reviewed the complete 85-file diff and recorded 77 distinct changed-source locations spanning every changed C file. The sample includes all 16 bounded payload-expression replacements and both new ORIGINAL BUG markers. No misleading new names, constants, field selections, widths, or bug descriptions were found. No local identifiers were renamed by this commit.

MCC68K measures the frame prefix as 4 bytes, piece stride as 10 bytes, and payload start as 4 in both views. All 1,287 metasprite units per revision satisfy prefix-plus-count sizing and have at most 12 pieces. Transition, uncover, drift, title, driving, intro, and ship frame bounds agree with their consumers. View sizes are not ROM allocation sizes.

All 35 existing MATCHING QUALIFICATION comments remain byte-for-byte present. The two additional markers centralize the inherited bounded-index constraint and explicitly label an unchanged unused-handle read. No new undisclosed compiler coaxing was found; the protected ShowShipPieces body is byte-for-byte unchanged as text.

The exact review/report contents and their public evidence files passed the same auditor path/content checks against both private ROMs before sealing. No ROM bytes, disassembly listing, or long encoded payload is included.

findings.what: Accepted matching qualification, not a defect: the 12-piece and 4-piece members are bounded access views retained for MCC68K word indexing. Their complete C sizes do not describe every variable-length ROM frame. The header states this explicitly, and both-revision extent checks support every changed consumer.
findings.suggested_fix: No change required for c030. Retain the MATCHING QUALIFICATION and never use these view sizes as ROM allocation sizes or frame-array strides.

limitations: The negative-coordinate ORIGINAL BUG marker describes an observed missing lower-bound guard. Reachability from an original caller remains unestablished, exactly as its comment discloses; no observed retail crash is claimed.

[INFERENCE] The historical source spelling is not established by byte equality. The review accepts the disclosed compiler qualifications, not a claim that these C views or steering idioms were in the 1991 source.
